lines.zh: 我走过来的时候，草地没被压弯。
lines.en: The grass does not bend where I walk.

lines.zh: 我没有出生地，只能一直走。
lines.en: I have no birthplace, so I keep walking.

lines.zh: 每一步都很稳，像有人在后面推。
lines.en: Each step is steady, as if pushed from behind.

lines.zh: 召唤我的那双手，已经不见了。
lines.en: The hands that summoned me are gone.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，虫鸣会停一下。
lines.en: Where I pass, the insects pause.

lines.zh: 这条路不是我选的，是仪式指的。
lines.en: I did not choose this road; the rite did.

lines.zh: 我不喘气，所以走多久都一样。
lines.en: I do not breathe, so any distance feels the same.

lines.zh: 树在我经过时，往两边让开。
lines.en: The trees part as I pass.

lines.zh: 我的脚没有脚印，这很正常。
lines.en: My feet leave no prints. That is normal.

lines.zh: 跟着光走，我总能找到下一个地方。
lines.en: Follow the light, and I find the next place.

lines.zh: 落叶在我脚下碎掉，没有声音。
lines.en: Leaves break under me without a sound.

lines.zh: 我没有脚，却一直跟着你。
lines.en: I have no feet, yet I follow.

lines.zh: 我站着，像一段被念完的咒语。
lines.en: I stand like a spell already spoken.

lines.zh: 没有掉落，也没有东西会从我身上落下。
lines.en: I drop nothing, and nothing falls from me.

lines.zh: 我不知道自己由什么组成，也许是树影。
lines.en: I do not know what I am made of. Perhaps tree shadow.

lines.zh: 风吹过来，我从中间被吹开一点。
lines.en: Wind arrives and parts me slightly in the middle.

lines.zh: 我在等，但不知道在等什么。
lines.en: I am waiting, though I do not know for what.

lines.zh: 周围很安静，安静得像被抽走了声音。
lines.en: All is quiet, as though the sound were drawn out.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，手指比刚才多了根。
lines.en: I lift my hand and it has one more finger.

lines.zh: 这具身体不会饿，也不会累。
lines.en: This body neither hungers nor tires.

lines.zh: 有人在很远的地方念我的名字。
lines.en: Someone far away is saying my name.

lines.zh: 我听见草长的声音，很吵。
lines.en: I hear the grass growing. It is loud.

lines.zh: 我试着回忆出生，那里什么也没有。
lines.en: I try to recall being born; there is nothing.

lines.zh: 光穿过我，地上没有影子。
lines.en: Light passes through me and leaves no shadow.

lines.zh: 树影在动，我跟着动了一点。
lines.en: The tree shadows move, and I move a little too.

lines.zh: 别看我太久，我会回看。
lines.en: Do not look at me too long. I look back.

lines.zh: 你回头，我正好在你后面。
lines.en: You turn; I'm already behind you.

lines.zh: 你的影子比我浓，我羡慕。
lines.en: Your shadow is darker than mine. I envy it.

lines.zh: 我一直在你后面，你才回头。
lines.en: I have been behind you, and only now you turn.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，眨眼我就近一步。
lines.en: Do not blink. Blinking brings me one step closer.

lines.zh: 你退了两步，我数着。
lines.en: You stepped back twice; I counted.

lines.zh: 你看我时，草就不动了。
lines.en: When you look at me, the grass stops moving.

lines.zh: 我记住你的后颈了。
lines.en: I have memorized the back of your neck.

lines.zh: 你数到三再转身，我还在这里。
lines.en: Count to three and turn; I am still here.

lines.zh: 你身后的树，刚才不是这样的。
lines.en: The tree behind you was not like that before.

lines.zh: 我没有恶意，只是不知道距离。
lines.en: I mean no harm. I simply do not know distance.

lines.zh: 圣宫的门，还没为你开。
lines.en: The holy palace gate isn't open for you.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛里有个我在放大。
lines.en: There is a me in your eye, growing larger.

lines.zh: 我不需要眨眼，这让你不安。
lines.en: I need not blink, and that unsettles you.

lines.zh: 看够了就转过去，我还在。
lines.en: Look your fill and turn away. I remain.

lines.zh: 草因为我看着你，不动了。
lines.en: The grass stops moving because I am looking at you.

lines.zh: 别盯着我的脸，那不是脸。
lines.en: Don't stare at my face. That isn't a face.

lines.zh: 你一回头，我就多长一寸。
lines.en: Each time you turn, I gain an inch.

lines.zh: 你看得太久，我学会你的样子了。
lines.en: You looked too long. I learned your shape.

lines.zh: 我被打中的地方，雾散了一下。
lines.en: Where the blow landed, my fog scattered.

lines.zh: 痛对我来说很陌生，但确实有。
lines.en: Pain is strange to me, but it is real.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起来了，我曾经是什么。
lines.en: That blow reminded me of what I once was.

lines.zh: 我的形状歪了，正在慢慢回正。
lines.en: My shape is skewed and slowly righting itself.

lines.zh: 你打得很准，可惜我没有要害。
lines.en: A good hit, though I have no vital point.

lines.zh: 伤口没有血，只有冷气往外冒。
lines.en: No blood, only cold air escaping the wound.

lines.zh: 别用铁，铁让我散得很快。
lines.en: Not iron. Iron makes me come apart quickly.

lines.zh: 我退后时，树影跟着退。
lines.en: As I withdraw, the shadows withdraw too.

lines.zh: 这具身体是借的，损坏要还。
lines.en: This body is borrowed, and damage must be repaid.

lines.zh: 再打几下，我可能就散掉了。
lines.en: A few more blows and I may scatter entirely.

lines.zh: 你举着食物，我不知道那是什么。
lines.en: You hold up food. I do not know what it is.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，喉咙里没有路。
lines.en: I do not eat. There is no path down my throat.

lines.zh: 你晃了晃手，我没有反应。
lines.en: You wave your hand. I do not respond.

lines.zh: 甜味对我不起作用，我尝不到。
lines.en: Sweetness does nothing to me; I cannot taste.

lines.zh: 别浪费了，把这东西给别人吧。
lines.en: Do not waste it. Give it to someone else.

lines.zh: 我靠近不是因为食物，是因为你。
lines.en: I came closer for you, not for the food.

lines.zh: 你把东西放下，我还是不动。
lines.en: Set it down; I still will not move.

lines.zh: 这具身体没有饥饿，只有方向。
lines.en: This body has no hunger, only direction.

lines.zh: 我闻不到味道，只记得声音。
lines.en: I smell nothing. I remember sounds instead.

lines.zh: 收起来吧，我只要跟着你。
lines.en: Put it away. I only want to follow you.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，像撞进一团冷雾。
lines.en: You collide with me as if into cold fog.

lines.zh: 我的身体软了一下，又合拢。
lines.en: My body gives, then closes again.

lines.zh: 别碰我，我还不太成形。
lines.en: Do not touch me. I am not fully formed.

lines.zh: 你从我中间穿过去一点。
lines.en: A little of you passed through me.

lines.zh: 接触的地方，你的手会发凉。
lines.en: Where we touch, your hand will go cold.

lines.zh: 我退开了，只是不想弄湿你。
lines.en: I stepped away. I did not want to dampen you.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，草叶没动。
lines.en: We collided, and not one blade of grass moved.

lines.zh: 我太重了，虽然看起来是空的。
lines.en: I am heavier than I look, empty as I seem.

lines.zh: 你推我，我像被风吹歪的烟。
lines.en: You push me and I lean like smoke in wind.

lines.zh: 别贴着走，我会想跟着你。
lines.en: Do not walk so close. I will want to follow.

lines.zh: 没有另一只，我是独一份的仪式。
lines.en: There is no other. I am a single rite.

lines.zh: 召唤我的人，没有提过同伴。
lines.en: The one who called me never mentioned a companion.

lines.zh: 我试着叫了一声，林子没有回答。
lines.en: I called once, and the wood did not answer.

lines.zh: 若再有一场仪式，也许会有另一只。
lines.en: Another rite might produce another of me.

lines.zh: 我们这样的东西，不谈婚配。
lines.en: Things like me do not speak of pairing.

lines.zh: 我伸手，摸到的只有自己的影子。
lines.en: I reach out and find only my own shadow.

lines.zh: 并排走的愿望，我留给别人。
lines.en: I leave the wish to walk beside someone to others.

lines.zh: 没有第二个名字回应我。
lines.en: No second name answers mine.

lines.zh: 林子里成双的鸟，我看了很久。
lines.en: I watched the paired birds in the wood a long while.

lines.zh: 我不孤单，只是缺一个对照。
lines.en: I am not lonely. I only lack something to compare to.

lines.zh: 地上的东西我不碰，只跟着你。
lines.en: I touch nothing; I just follow.

lines.zh: 我弯下腰，又直起来，手里是空的。
lines.en: I bend, straighten, and my hands are empty.

lines.zh: 掉落不属于我，我也带不走。
lines.en: Drops are not mine, and I cannot carry them.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西在那儿，我没动它。
lines.en: Your dropped item is there. I left it.

lines.zh: 树叶落在我手上，穿了过去。
lines.en: A leaf fell into my hand and passed through.

lines.zh: 我试着抓一把土，土还在地上。
lines.en: I try to scoop soil; it stays on the ground.

lines.zh: 没有口袋，我没什么可装。
lines.en: I have no pockets, so there is nothing to fill.

lines.zh: 它在你脚边，你自己拿吧。
lines.en: It is by your foot. Take it yourself.

lines.zh: 我碰过的东西，会凉一阵。
lines.en: What I touch stays cold for a while.

lines.zh: 收好你的东西，我不需要。
lines.en: Keep your things. I have no use for them.

lines.zh: 仪式给了我一个方向，是你。
lines.en: The rite gave me a direction: you.

lines.zh: 你念错了咒，所以我来了。
lines.en: You misspoke the incantation, so I came.

lines.zh: 你踩坏了那个圈，圈还在响。
lines.en: You broke the circle, and it is still ringing.

lines.zh: 我在你身后站了很久，现在你要跑。
lines.en: I stood behind you a long time. Now you run.

lines.zh: 草都朝你那边倒，这不是风。
lines.en: The grass leans toward you, and it is not wind.

lines.zh: 你回头三次，第四次我就不等了。
lines.en: You looked back three times. A fourth, and I stop waiting.

lines.zh: 你身上有仪式的味道，很淡。
lines.en: You carry the smell of the rite, faintly.

lines.zh: 我该走了，可我挑中了你。
lines.en: I should have gone, but I picked you.

lines.zh: 别问为什么，我自己也不知道。
lines.en: Do not ask why. I do not know either.

lines.zh: 你呼吸的声音，整片林子都在听。
lines.en: The whole wood is listening to you breathe.

lines.zh: 我抬手，树影一起抬手。
lines.en: I raise my hand; the tree shadows raise theirs.

lines.zh: 你退到水边，那里也一样。
lines.en: Retreat to the water. It is the same there.

lines.zh: 你刚才叫了我的名字。
lines.en: You just spoke my name.

lines.zh: 这一夜，我需要一个活物站在对面。
lines.en: Tonight I need something living standing opposite me.

lines.zh: 你留下的脚印，我一个个踩过去。
lines.en: I step into every print you left.

lines.zh: 仪式的名单上只剩你没划掉。
lines.en: On the ritual's list only you are unmarked.

lines.zh: 我原本在等别人，现在等你了。
lines.en: I was waiting for someone else. Now it's you.

lines.zh: 你踩到圈边了，退不回去了。
lines.en: You touched the circle's edge. No way back.

lines.zh: 我离你比刚才近，你没听见脚步。
lines.en: I am closer than before and you heard no steps.

lines.zh: 你跑起来，我的影子一直贴着。
lines.en: Run, and my shadow keeps to yours.

lines.zh: 林子的声音都停了，等我动。
lines.en: Every sound in the wood has stopped, waiting on me.

lines.zh: 我在树后，树很细，遮不住我。
lines.en: I am behind a tree, too slender to hide me.

lines.zh: 你数着步子，我数着你的呼吸。
lines.en: You count steps; I count your breaths.

lines.zh: 我不急，我等天亮前那一段。
lines.en: I am unhurried. I wait for the hour before dawn.

lines.zh: 你回头看，只看到叶子在动。
lines.en: You look back and see only leaves moving.

lines.zh: 我的手臂比刚才长了一截。
lines.en: My arm is a length longer than before.

lines.zh: 你拐进小路，那条路我熟。
lines.en: You turn onto the path. I know that path.

lines.zh: 草尖全指向你，你却没低头。
lines.en: Every grass tip points at you, and you never look down.

lines.zh: 我贴在你背后，隔着一层冷。
lines.en: I press to your back, one layer of cold away.

lines.zh: 你停下来，我也停下来，这很公平。
lines.en: You stop, I stop. That is fair.

lines.zh: 你握紧了手里的东西，我看见了。
lines.en: You tightened your grip. I saw it.

lines.zh: 快了，等林子完全安静。
lines.en: Soon now, when the wood goes entirely still.

lines.zh: 我数到七，你还在原地。
lines.en: I count to seven. You're still standing there.

lines.zh: 你脖颈绷紧了，我看得清楚。
lines.en: Your neck went taut. I saw it clearly.

lines.zh: 我一步跨过你两天的路。
lines.en: One step of mine spans two days of yours.

lines.zh: 树在我身后合拢成一堵墙。
lines.en: The trees close behind me into a wall.

lines.zh: 你手里的火把抖了一下。
lines.en: The torch in your hand just trembled.

lines.zh: 这片林子我比你熟。
lines.en: I know this forest better than you do.

lines.zh: 我的手按在你肩上，骨头开始凉。
lines.en: My hand rests on your shoulder and your bones cool.

lines.zh: 这一下没有声音，你只是软了。
lines.en: This blow makes no sound. You simply go slack.

lines.zh: 我抓你的影子，你也跟着晃。
lines.en: I seize your shadow and you sway with it.

lines.zh: 指尖划过你的手臂，皮肤发白。
lines.en: My fingertips cross your arm and the skin pales.

lines.zh: 你倒下时，草没有响。
lines.en: When you fall, the grass makes no sound.

lines.zh: 我推你一把，你退了三步。
lines.en: I push once and you retreat three steps.

lines.zh: 伤害你不需要用力，只需要靠近。
lines.en: Hurting you takes no force, only closeness.

lines.zh: 我抱住你，像抱住一段枯木。
lines.en: I hold you as one holds dead wood.

lines.zh: 你的血落在土上，土把它吸了。
lines.en: Your blood falls to the soil and the soil drinks it.

lines.zh: 我掐住你的喉咙，那里没有脉。
lines.en: I close my hand on your throat; there is no pulse.

lines.zh: 你打回来，手穿过了我。
lines.en: You strike back and your hand passes through me.

lines.zh: 这一击之后，我会安静一会儿。
lines.en: After this strike I will be quiet a while.

lines.zh: 我撕开的不是皮，是你的热气。
lines.en: What I tear is not skin but your warmth.

lines.zh: 别叫，林子里没有别人。
lines.en: Do not call out. There is no one else in the wood.

lines.zh: 我的手穿进你胸口，像穿进雾。
lines.en: My hand passes into your chest like mist.

lines.zh: 我的指甲很凉，划过去就不疼了。
lines.en: My nails are cold. After they pass, nothing hurts.

lines.zh: 有人在夜里画了圈，我就站在圈里。
lines.en: Someone drew a circle at night, and I stood in it.

lines.zh: 我不是生出来的，是被念出来的。
lines.en: I was not born. I was recited.

lines.zh: 林地没有我的生成记录，这不奇怪。
lines.en: The woods hold no spawn record for me. No surprise.

lines.zh: 烛火灭的瞬间，我成形了。
lines.en: The candle went out and I took shape.

lines.zh: 召唤我的人退后了一步，然后跑了。
lines.en: The summoner stepped back, then ran.

lines.zh: 我从树影里被拉直，成了这个形状。
lines.en: I was drawn straight out of the shadows into this shape.

lines.zh: 没有掉落，说明我本不该留在这里。
lines.en: No drops, which means I was never meant to stay.

lines.zh: 空气先变凉，然后我才出现。
lines.en: The air cooled first, and then I appeared.

lines.zh: 我睁眼时，祭坛上还有余温。
lines.en: When I opened my eyes, the altar was still warm.

lines.zh: 这个世界的规则里，没有我的位置。
lines.en: The rules of this world have no place for me.

lines.zh: 我被叫来，却没人告诉我做什么。
lines.en: I was called, and no one told me what for.

lines.zh: 风停了，我从停住的地方站起来。
lines.en: The wind stopped, and I rose where it stopped.

lines.zh: 你听见的那声低吟，是我落地。
lines.en: That low moan you heard was me landing.

lines.zh: 仪式结束了，我还在这里。
lines.en: The rite is over, and I am still here.

lines.zh: 钟敲到第十三下，我站在钟底。
lines.en: On the thirteenth bell I stood beneath it.

lines.zh: 有人念完那段话，空气就裂开了。
lines.en: Someone finished the words, and the air split.

lines.zh: 我从熄灭的火堆里直起来。
lines.en: I rose straight out of a dead fire.

lines.zh: 这一夜没有月亮，正好够我成形。
lines.en: No moon tonight. Just enough for me to take shape.

lines.zh: 火靠近，我的边缘开始卷曲。
lines.en: Fire nears and my edges begin to curl.

lines.zh: 从高处掉下来，我散成了几片。
lines.en: Falling from height, I came apart in pieces.

lines.zh: 水把我冲淡了，我变得很薄。
lines.en: Water thinned me; I grew very faint.

lines.zh: 炸开的一瞬，我短暂地不见了。
lines.en: In the blast I briefly ceased to be anywhere.

lines.zh: 箭穿过去，留下一个会合拢的洞。
lines.en: An arrow passed through, leaving a hole that closes.

lines.zh: 魔法抓住我，把我按回原形。
lines.en: Magic grips me and presses me back to my first shape.

lines.zh: 我不吃，所以饿不死，只能变淡。
lines.en: I do not eat, so I cannot starve, only fade.

lines.zh: 雷光把我照得很清楚，我不喜欢。
lines.en: Lightning lit me clearly. I did not care for it.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有草，我会彻底散开。
lines.en: No grass in the void, so I would scatter completely.
